s.note: Fresh shucked oysters on crushed ice with an eschalot and cracked pepper dressing
s.how: Finely dice 2 eschalots and stir into 100ml red wine vinegar with cracked black pepper. Lay a dozen freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice. Spoon a little dressing over each and serve with lemon wedges, like a fancy Chicago lunch.

s.note: Sticky honey, soy and garlic wings, baked crisp, for Kimmy at the mic
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy sauce and crushed garlic until sticky. Toss the wings through and scatter with sesame seeds. Sing badly between bites.

m.note: Seared sirloin, cracked pepper cream sauce, thin fries
m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thin fries and fry twice until crisp. Sear 4 sirloin steaks and rest. Toast cracked peppercorns in the pan, add 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Serve with the fries and a green salad, reviewed harshly.

w.note: Vanilla bean custard beside the raspberry jelly Michael wants
w.how: Make up a packet of raspberry jelly and set in small cups. Heat 600ml cream with a split vanilla bean, whisk into 6 yolks and 80g sugar, strain into ramekins and bake in a water bath at 150C for 35 minutes. Chill, torch the sugar and serve with the jelly.

d.note: Raspberry puree in a flute, topped slowly with cold bubbles
d.how: Crush 125g raspberries with 1 tbsp caster sugar and the juice of half a lemon and push through a sieve. Spoon 1 tbsp of purée into each of 4 flutes. Slowly top with cold sparkling wine from a 750ml bottle and drop a whole raspberry in each. For non-drinkers, use sparkling grape juice.
